build_spaced_diffusion: build a SpacedDiffusion process that skips steps in a base GaussianDiffusion using selected timesteps
create_space_timesteps: create a set of diffusion timesteps from section counts or a ddimN stride string
test_space_timesteps_ddim: test space_timesteps with a ddimN string to get DDIM-style integer-strided timesteps
review_SpacedDiffusion_p_mean_variance: review SpacedDiffusion p_mean_variance which wraps the model before computing mean and variance
refactor_SpacedDiffusion_training_losses: refactor SpacedDiffusion training_losses to wrap the model with timestep mapping before computing losses
